summary: Returns finalized probe cluster info once the probe is done and either sequence coverage or RTT-based settle timing has been satisfied.
summary_step: 1. Refuses finalization until the probe cluster has been marked done.
2. Finalizes immediately when the tracked probe packet sequence has reached the supplied max sequence number.
3. Computes settle wait from configured RTT multiplier and clamps it between min and max durations.
4. Waits until the settle duration has elapsed before returning valid probe cluster info.
